Intro: I greet you again, young one. I must say, I am literally starving for thy meals! The war has changed me so much that why, I feel like a new man!
Never in my lifespan would I enjoy such disgusting cuisine. The nation will adapt to such new techniques. I exist to taste it myself, first in line!
Why, I'm feeling adventurous today. Bring me something nice, but include some Spoilage in there. Do not worry, you can trust me. I trusted you.
Success: Ohhh. Come to daddy, little worms. I have a special place just for you.
Fail: Well, it's the thought that counts. Thine worms will act as sustenance. Thine bread burns on the plate.
Reject: Do people not enjoy a fine taste anymore? Has the Gourmet Age finally come to an end? My heart feels heavy. Maybe I need to change for this new dawn.
